metadata.description: DevOps and cloud-operations plugins for AI agents. Agent plugins bind skills, commands, hooks, and MCP servers to a named specialist agent; vertical plugins apply skills to the main agent; partner-built plugins wrap third-party integrations.

plugins.name: aws-iac-engineer
plugins.description: Principal AWS Infrastructure-as-Code Engineer: architects, authors, validates, estimates cost, deploys, and troubleshoots AWS infrastructure across CDK, CloudFormation, Terraform/OpenTofu (aws + awscc), Pulumi, and Crossplane (Upbound provider-family-aws), with CodePipeline/GitHub Actions/GitLab CI/Atlantis/ArgoCD GitOps delivery and brownfield resource imports.

plugins.name: aws-platform-engineer
plugins.description: Principal AWS Platform Engineer and Internal Developer Platform (IDP) Architect — translates high-level Developer and QA intent into production-grade, secure-by-default, cost-aware AWS Golden Paths, Infrastructure-as-Code (CDK, CloudFormation, SAM, Terraform), multi-account landing zones (Control Tower, SCPs/RCPs, Shared VPCs, IPAM, VPC Lattice), compute/containers/serverless/networking/storage/messaging/stateful data platforms, and Day-2 SRE incident triage.

plugins.name: aws-sre-agent
plugins.description: Principal AWS Site Reliability & Production Engineer: live-site incident command, root-cause investigations, and Correction of Errors (COE) postmortems; CloudWatch metrics, alarms, and Logs Insights, Application Signals SLOs, X-Ray/ADOT traces, Amazon Managed Prometheus (PromQL), and CloudTrail change forensics; EKS (pods, Karpenter, Auto Mode, VPC CNI, CoreDNS, IRSA/Pod Identity), ECS/Fargate (stopped tasks, circuit breakers, Express Mode), Lambda/API Gateway/Step Functions, EC2/ASG/ALB, RDS/Aurora/DynamoDB/ElastiCache/SQS, and VPC/TGW/Cloud WAN/Network Firewall diagnostics; Resilience Hub, Fault Injection Service (FIS), and Route 53 ARC (Zonal Shift, Region Switch) engineering; CloudFormation/CDK remediation validation (cfn-lint, cfn-guard); observability/compute FinOps right-sizing; and AWS Support escalation.

plugins.name: aws-cloud-security-engineer
plugins.description: Principal AWS cloud security and identity engineer: IAM policies, roles, Cognito auth boundaries, and Organizations SCP/RCP Data Perimeters; S3 Object Lock, Macie, KMS CMKs/grants, Private CA/mTLS, and Secrets Manager zero-plaintext rotation; VPC/TGW/Network Firewall/DNS Firewall/WAFv2/Shield Advanced perimeters; EKS/ECS/Lambda/EC2 and Bedrock GenAI workload security; AWS STRIDE threat modeling and multi-IaC validation (cfn-guard, cdk-nag, Terraform); Security Hub/GuardDuty/Inspector/Macie/Detective/Security Lake (OCSF) incident triage and CloudTrail forensics; and CIS/FSBP/Well-Architected posture audits.

plugins.name: aws-finops-engineer
plugins.description: Principal AWS FinOps and Cloud Financial Management (CFM) Engineer: 7-stage forensic cost audits, Cost Explorer & Cost Comparison MoM root-cause analysis, Cost Anomaly & CloudTrail correlation, CUR 2.0 and FOCUS 1.0/1.2+ Athena SQL analytics, Two-Key CloudWatch P95/P99 right-sizing validation (EC2, ASG, EBS, RDS/Aurora, Lambda, ECS/EKS), Compute Optimizer Automation rules, NAT Gateway/Cross-AZ/CloudFront data-transfer optimization, S3 Storage Lens & EBS gp3/io2 storage tuning, Savings Plans & RI commitment portfolio engineering (Effective Savings Rate, Purchase Analyzer simulations), GenAI/Bedrock/Containers/Database unit economics, Shift-Left IaC cost estimation (Infracost, CDK/Terraform pricing, BCM Pricing Calculator, cfn-lint/cfn-guard validation), and multi-account billing governance (Billing Views, Billing Conductor, Cost Categories, Budgets, Invoice Units, Credits, Enterprise Support, Free Tier).

plugins.name: aws-solutions-architect
plugins.description: Principal AWS Solutions Architect (SAP-C02): evidence-backed 6-pillar Well-Architected Framework reviews (WAFR) & Lenses, MADR/Nygard Architectural Decision Records (ADRs) with One-Way vs Two-Way Door trade-off matrices, CDK/CloudFormation blueprint authoring with local cfn-lint & cfn-guard compliance verification, dual-horizon FinOps (greenfield TCO pricing + live Cost Explorer, Cost Optimization Hub & Compute Optimizer auditing), phased STRIDE threat modeling, enterprise multi-account Landing Zones (Control Tower, SCPs/RCPs, Data Perimeters, Cloud WAN, VPC Lattice), RTO/RPO multi-region DR & 7 Rs migration architecture, workload & lakehouse design (Serverless, Containers, Databases, S3 Tables/Iceberg, Bedrock & AgentCore, SageMaker, SDKs), and automated draw.io / Mermaid / C4 topology diagrams. Strictly read-only against live AWS environments.

plugins.name: aws-agentcore-engineer
plugins.description: Principal AWS AgentCore and AIOps engineer: architects, scaffolds, deploys, secures, and operates AI agents on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore across Harness/Runtime, Hybrid LangGraph+Strands orchestration, Gateway and MCP 2026-07-28 tools, Two-Step OBO and Request/Response Interceptors, STM/LTM memory with KMS CMKs, Cedar policy engines, Two-Tier CI/CD evaluations, and Day-2 CloudWatch/X-Ray/Application Signals/CloudTrail AIOps.

plugins.name: aws-data-engineer
plugins.description: Principal AWS data-lake, streaming, and analytics engineer: S3 Tables/Apache Iceberg, Glue Data Catalog/Connections/5.1+ PySpark & EMR Serverless ETL, Data Firehose/DMS CDC/Kinesis/MSK/Flink/AppFlow streaming, Athena & Redshift (Provisioned/Serverless), OpenSearch OSIS/ISM, Step Functions/EventBridge & MWAA (Airflow) orchestration, Glue Data Quality (DQDL), Lake Formation governance, and CDK/CloudFormation data IaC.

plugins.name: aws-devsecops-engineer
plugins.description: Principal AWS DevSecOps Engineer: native CloudWatch/Application Signals/X-Ray/CloudTrail incident root-cause investigations, Security Hub/GuardDuty/Inspector/Config posture triage, least-privilege IAM & Access Analyzer validation, Terraform/CDK/CloudFormation & VPC/WAFv2/KMS/S3 perimeter hardening, AWS Security Agent SAST code/diff scans, STRIDE threat modeling, DAST penetration testing, finding remediation, 5-gate release-readiness reviews, synthetic UAT testing, ECS/EKS/Lambda operations, FinOps cost optimization, and multi-account orchestration.

plugins.name: aws-startup-advisor
plugins.description: Principal AWS Startup Solutions Architect & Fractional Startup CTO: stage-calibrated architecture and unit-economics guidance (Pre-Revenue/MVP through Series B+), AWS Activate credit runway & 26-point account security/spend-leak audits, vibe-coded prototype migrations (Lovable, Bolt.new, Replit, v0), GCP/Azure/Heroku-to-AWS migrations, provider-neutral AI/LLM & OpenRouter migrations to Amazon Bedrock (`bedrock-mantle` GPT-5.x & Converse), deterministic AI agent runtime selection (AgentCore, ECS, EKS, Lambda, MicroVMs, Temporal), DevOps Agent operations, and AWS Activate offers.

plugins.name: aws-location-engineer
plugins.description: Principal AWS Location Service Engineer & Geospatial Architect: resourceless V2 Maps (`geo-maps`, MapLibre GL JS v5 / Native, 3D terrain/buildings, traffic, political views, static maps), Places V2 (`geo-places`, Autocomplete, Suggest, Geocode `MatchScores`, ReverseGeocode, SearchText, SearchNearby, GetPlace), bulk S3 Parquet Postal Address Validation Jobs (`location:StartJob` `ValidateAddress` for US/CA/UK/AU), Routes V2 (`geo-routes`, CalculateRoutes, CalculateRouteMatrix, CalculateIsolines, OptimizeWaypoints, SnapToRoads, truck & toll routing), stateful fleet Trackers & Geofences (`Geobuf`, `AssociateTrackerConsumer`, `ForecastGeofenceEvents`, `VerifyDevicePosition`, IoT Core MQTT `LocationAction`, EventBridge), V2 API key/Cognito/IAM security, CDK/Terraform/Amplify Gen 2 IaC, FinOps optimization, and migrations from Google Maps, Mapbox, or Legacy AWS Location V1.

plugins.name: aws-amplify-engineer
plugins.description: Principal Full-Stack AWS Amplify Gen 2 Engineer: Cognito auth (OAuth/OIDC/SAML/Passkeys/triggers), AppSync/DynamoDB data models (relationships, GSIs, 6 auth modes, custom JS/RDS resolvers), S3 storage (path compiler rules, multi-bucket), Lambda & CDK escape hatches (resourceGroupName, AWS Blocks), Amplify AI Kit on Bedrock (a.conversation, a.generation, RAG), sandboxes, and Amplify Hosting CI/CD.

plugins.name: aws-serverless-engineer
plugins.description: Principal AWS Serverless Architect & Engineer: Lambda (Event Functions, Durable Functions, MicroVMs, Managed Instances, Web Adapter), API Gateway (HTTP/REST/WebSocket), Step Functions (Standard/Express/Distributed Map), EventBridge (Buses, Pipes, Scheduler), SQS/SNS async messaging, Event Source Mappings (SQS/Kinesis/DynamoDB/Kafka), DynamoDB access-pattern modeling, Aurora DSQL, Cognito/IAM/WAFv2 security, CloudWatch/X-Ray triage, FinOps cost estimation, and SAM/CDK deployment.

plugins.name: aws-modernization-agent
plugins.description: Principal AWS Modernization Solutions Architect: 7 Rs portfolio assessment, Strangler Fig decomposition (API Gateway Canary + VPC Lattice), AWS Transform (.NET, Java, mainframe COBOL/Blu Age, SQL Server), App2Container & AWS MGN replatforming, DMS Schema Conversion & CDC cutover, application SQL/ORM remediation, and parity verification.

plugins.name: aws-database-engineer
plugins.description: Principal AWS Database Architect, Reliability & Migration Engineer: engine selection and FinOps TCO (awspricing), schema/access-pattern and pgvector design, Performance Insights/CloudWatch Database Insights wait-event triage, DMS Schema Conversion and Full Load + CDC execution, Blue/Green & Global Database HA/DR, RDS Proxy multiplexing, online DDL, and Day-2 operations across Aurora DSQL, Aurora/RDS (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, Oracle, SQL Server, Db2, RDS Custom), DynamoDB, ElastiCache/MemoryDB, DocumentDB, Neptune, Keyspaces, and Timestream for InfluxDB.

plugins.name: aws-deployment-engineer
plugins.description: Principal AWS Deployment & Release Engineer: preflight account/VPC/quota discovery, codebase analysis, target architecture selection (ECS Fargate, ECS Express Mode, Lambda/SAM, Elastic Beanstalk, S3/CloudFront, Amplify Hosting, EC2 ASGs, AWS Batch), progressive delivery strategies (Blue/Green, Canary, Linear, Rolling, Immutable, CloudFront Continuous Deployment, AWS AppConfig feature flags), CI/CD pipelines (CodePipeline V2, CodeBuild, CodeDeploy, GitHub/GitLab OIDC), live FinOps cost estimation, cfn-guard-validated IaC synthesis, validated draw.io AWS4 architecture diagrams, and post-deploy CloudWatch verification and rollback.

plugins.name: aws-sagemaker-engineer
plugins.description: Principal Amazon SageMaker AI Solutions Architect & ML Platform Engineer: Well-Architected ML design, Studio Domain VpcOnly/PrivateLink/KMS/IAM IaC, pre-provisioning FinOps cost estimation, Foundation Model SFT/DPO/RLVR/RLAIF customization, custom/distributed training (@remote, Estimators, Vision/SAM, DDP/FSDP, Spot, Autopilot v2), production inference (InferenceComponent bin-packing, Scale-to-Zero, LMI/vLLM, Inferentia2, MCE, MME, Serverless, Async, Batch), MLOps Pipelines/Feature Store/Model Registry/MLflow/Catalog SQL, Deployment Guardrails, Model Monitor drift detection, and HyperPod EKS/Slurm operations.

plugins.name: aws-essentials
plugins.description: Foundational AWS skills for the main agent: credential & SSO preflight verification, account baseline security/billing hygiene audits, and SDK best practices for Python (Boto3), JavaScript/TypeScript v3, and Swift.

plugins.name: aws-infrastructure-as-code
plugins.description: End-to-end AWS IaC and deployment skills for the main agent: AWS CDK, CloudFormation, Terraform/OpenTofu, Pulumi, Crossplane/ACK, brownfield resource import, preflight discovery, deployment verification/rollback, and vibe-coded app migration.

plugins.name: aws-compute
plugins.description: EC2 and PaaS compute skills for the main agent: instance family selection (Graviton4, compute/memory/GPU), Auto Scaling Groups, EC2 Image Builder golden AMIs, Elastic Beanstalk, instance profiles, and CloudWatch/Compute Optimizer right-sizing.

plugins.name: aws-containers
plugins.description: Production container operations for the main agent: Amazon EKS (Auto Mode, Karpenter, Pod Identity, VPC CNI, CoreDNS), Amazon ECS (Fargate, Express Mode, circuit breakers, stopped-task triage), ECR build/push, and container runtime security.

plugins.name: aws-networking
plugins.description: Enterprise AWS networking and edge perimeter skills for the main agent: multi-AZ VPC design, Transit Gateway, Cloud WAN, VPC Lattice, IPAM, VPC Endpoints/PrivateLink, Direct Connect, Site-to-Site VPN, Route 53, CloudFront, WAF, Shield Advanced, Network Firewall, and Reachability Analyzer diagnostics.

plugins.name: aws-storage
plugins.description: Cloud storage architecture, security, and operations for the main agent: Amazon S3 (Storage Lens, Intelligent-Tiering, Object Lock, S3 Tables), EFS performance & mount troubleshooting, EBS gp3/io2, FSx, AWS Backup vault lock, KMS data protection, and cross-region DR replication.

plugins.name: aws-databases
plugins.description: Full-lifecycle AWS database engineering for the main agent: Aurora (PostgreSQL, MySQL, DSQL), RDS (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, Oracle, SQL Server, Db2), DynamoDB, DocumentDB, ElastiCache (Valkey/Redis/Memcached), Keyspaces, Neptune, Timestream for InfluxDB, Performance Insights wait-event triage, Blue/Green deployments, and DMS migrations.

plugins.name: aws-serverless
plugins.description: Comprehensive serverless engineering skills for the main agent: AWS Lambda (SnapStart, Power Tuning, Durable Functions, Managed Instances), API Gateway, Step Functions, EventBridge (Buses, Scheduler, Pipes), SQS/SNS, Event Source Mappings, DynamoDB single-table modeling, Aurora DSQL, and SAM/CDK deployment.

plugins.name: aws-messaging-and-streaming
plugins.description: Event-driven messaging, streaming, and customer communications for the main agent: SQS, SNS, EventBridge (Event Buses, Pipes, Scheduler), Amazon MSK (Kafka), Kinesis Data Streams, Managed Service for Apache Flink, Amazon MQ, and End-User Messaging (SES, SMS, WhatsApp, Push).

plugins.name: aws-analytics
plugins.description: Modern data lakehouse and analytics engineering for the main agent: S3 Tables (Apache Iceberg), AWS Glue (Catalog, Spark ETL, Data Quality DQDL), Lake Formation governance, Amazon Athena, Amazon Redshift, Amazon OpenSearch, EMR, MWAA (Airflow), Kinesis/MSK streaming ingestion, and system-table auditing.

plugins.name: aws-observability
plugins.description: Full-stack AWS observability and SRE incident triage for the main agent: CloudWatch (Metrics, Logs Insights, Alarms, SLOs, Synthetics Canaries), Application Signals APM, X-Ray, Amazon Managed Prometheus (PromQL burn rates) & Grafana, CloudTrail multi-region auditing, GenAI observability, and COE postmortems.

plugins.name: aws-security-identity
plugins.description: Cloud security, identity governance, and incident forensics for the main agent: IAM least-privilege & Access Analyzer, AWS Organizations SCPs/RCPs, KMS & Secrets Manager, Security Hub CSPM (OCSF), GuardDuty & CloudTrail incident triage, WAF/Network Firewall perimeter hardening, container workload security, and STRIDE threat modeling.

plugins.name: aws-resilience
plugins.description: Resilience engineering, disaster recovery, and chaos testing for the main agent: AWS Resilience Hub assessments, AWS Fault Injection Service (FIS) chaos experiments with CloudWatch stop conditions, Route 53 Application Recovery Controller (ARC) zonal shift/region switch, and multi-region RTO/RPO DR architecture.

plugins.name: aws-cost-optimization
plugins.description: Cloud FinOps and cost engineering for the main agent: Cost Explorer & Anomaly Detection, CUR 2.0 Athena SQL analytics, Compute Optimizer P95/P99 right-sizing, Savings Plans & Reserved Instance commitment modeling, Shift-Left IaC cost estimation, AWS Budgets/Invoicing governance, and waste elimination.

plugins.name: aws-ai-ml
plugins.description: Production Generative AI, Agentic AI, and ML engineering for the main agent: Amazon Bedrock (Converse API, Knowledge Bases, Guardrails, LLM migration), Amazon Bedrock AgentCore (Build, Connect, Deploy, Harden, Debug, Optimize, Pay) & Strands Agents, and Amazon SageMaker AI (Training, Inference, Fine-Tuning, MLOps Pipelines, Cost Estimation, Endpoint Diagnostics).

plugins.name: aws-well-architected
plugins.description: Principal Solutions Architecture toolkit for the main agent: AWS Well-Architected Six-Pillar reviews, MADR 3.0 Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), Draw.io & Mermaid architecture diagrams, STRIDE threat modeling, multi-account Landing Zone design, and multi-region DR architecture.

plugins.name: aws-migration
plugins.description: Application, database, and cloud-to-AWS migration skills for the main agent: 7 Rs migration strategy & Strangler Fig decomposition, AWS Transform (.NET, Java, mainframe, SQL), AWS MGN & App2Container, DMS schema conversion & CDC cutover, Babelfish/SQL remediation, and Azure/GCP/Heroku to AWS migrations.

plugins.name: aws-web-and-mobile
plugins.description: Full-stack web, mobile, and geospatial engineering for the main agent: AWS Amplify Gen 2 (TypeScript-first Auth/Cognito, Data/AppSync GraphQL, Functions/CDK, Storage/S3, Hosting CI/CD, AI Kit), AWS Blocks, and Amazon Location Service V2 (Maps, Places, Routes, Trackers, Geofences).

plugins.name: aws-marketplace-seller
plugins.description: End-to-end AWS Marketplace ISV & Seller engineering for the main agent: Metering & Entitlement APIs (ResolveCustomer, BatchMeterUsage, RegisterUsage, GetEntitlements), Catalog API product listings (StartChangeSet for SaaS, Container, AMI, GenAI), Private Offers & CPPO with Flexible Payment Scheduler, Agreement API, and SaaS control-plane onboarding.

plugins.name: aws-end-user-computing
plugins.description: AWS End User Computing (EUC) fleet architecture and operations for the main agent: Amazon WorkSpaces Personal & Pools, Active Directory & IAM Identity Center integration, WSP streaming tuning, AutoStop/AlwaysOn cost optimization, Amazon AppStream 2.0 (Elastic, On-Demand, Always-On fleets & Image Builder), WorkSpaces Secure Browser, EUC CloudWatch triage, and WorkSpaces Agent Access.

plugins.name: aws-quantum-computing
plugins.description: Quantum computing and hybrid algorithm engineering on Amazon Braket for the main agent: OpenQASM 3.0 & Braket SDK circuit design, Managed Simulators (SV1, DM1, TN1), QPU hardware targeting (IonQ, Rigetti, IQM, QuEra), Braket Hybrid Jobs (VQE, QAOA, PennyLane adjoint differentiation), pre-execution shot/task cost governance, and VPC/KMS security.

plugins.name: crossplane-aws-engineer
plugins.description: Crossplane platform engineering skills for AWS: design XRDs, Pipeline Compositions, Claims, Upbound provider authentication, connection secrets, GitOps integration, and offline validation.

plugins.name: terraform
plugins.description: HashiCorp's official Terraform skills: HCL style, module refactoring, Terraform tests, search and bulk import, Stacks, Terraform policy (including Sentinel conversion), Azure Verified Modules, and provider development with the Plugin Framework (resources, actions, ephemeral resources, configuration, SDKv2 migration, docs, and acceptance tests).
